title: Spicy Fregola Pilaf
description: A warm and aromatic Mediterranean-inspired vegetarian pilaf made with fregola pasta, infused with the flavors of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the fregola pasta, diced tomatoes, spicy paprika, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the fregola is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and top with chopped parsley, if desired.
